title: Global Wealth Management Intern - Commercial Team

titleByLocale.en: Global Wealth Management Intern - Commercial Team
titleByLocale.it: Global Wealth Management Tirocinante - Commercial Team
titleByLocale.de: Global Wealth Management Praktikant - Commercial Team
titleByLocale.fr: Global Wealth Management Stagiaire - Commercial Team

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you communicative and want to develop your knowledge about investments in the local and international market? Do you want to work in a Multi-Family Office?

We are looking for an intern to:
• support to the Commercial Area and Relationship Executives
• help the prepare of analyses and reports on the investment portfolio of clients
• assist the Client Advisor Assistants with clients’ documentation (contract, KYC, suitability, among others), according to the internal flows of UBS Consensus and with the requirements of the business partners chosen by our clients
• make contact Banks and Custodians
• meet the operational demands of the commercial team
